text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Lately, our training regimen was designed 
under the assumption that Sakura Chiyono O 
had already passed her peak.

Even if your stamina falls behind the 
up-and-comers, your strength as an athlete 
can still be heightened.

"Even if you can't run by brute force 
alone, you can train your explosiveness 
and quick thinking. There are countless 
areas where you can grow."

And how we bring her into peak condition 
for the real deal will also be crucial. We 
absolutely must avoid any injuries.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Eep... Isn't there way too much ice in 
this bucket? My... my legs are... s-so 
cold...
choice_data_list:
We need to hold back so fatigue doesn't 
build up.

text_block_list.text:
"At any rate, I felt we should try 
anything that could lead to her growth 
right now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san's Trainer. I apologize for 
calling you out so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This is... for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This is a training routine proposed 
earlier by my attending physician. It is 
specialized in improving muscle function 
without causing strain or injury.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I do not know what burdens you all carry, 
but I know exactly what kind of menu you 
are craving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My legs were fragile. But I accepted that 
as part of who I am, and I was always 
searching for ways to grow.
choice_data_list: ...Thank you, I'll be sure to treasure it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...No, think nothing of it. So... please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please take good care of my rival.

The paper bag she handed me had a 
reassuring heft to it.

Using the materials received from Mejiro 
Ardan, I immediately began exploring a new 
routine. When I went to ask Sakura Chiyono 
O for her opinion—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san. I apologize for roping you 
into Ardan-san's mock race the other day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What's wrong, Yaeno-san?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I chose the wrong way to 
encourage you. With that in mind, allow me 
to apologize and offer one piece of 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A teaching, you say?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Our 'Kongo Yaegaki Style' is a 
martial art specialized in defense.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, in order to protect, sometimes 
rather than restoring what is broken, one 
must shatter it completely.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I was brought before my master, 
sometimes a path can only be opened by 
daring to tear it down."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't forget that resolve. 
...Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yaeno-san.

Neither of the two should have known what 
condition Sakura Chiyono O was in.

Even so, they sensed something was amiss. 
And they were trying to help.
choice_data_list: You've got some great rivals, don't you

You've found yourself some wonderful 
rivals, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, I can't just stand still. Not 
as their rival, either...!

And on the final day of the summer 
training camp—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No more living in fear. Even if it's 
fragile, I will accept it... Not by 
restoring what was broken, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Smash it to pieces...!!

Sakura Chiyono O dashed across the beach, 
running with everything she currently had.

"Her time was 1.1 seconds faster than it 
was last winter."
